### Thomas Hobbes on nature

Thomas Hobbes (1588–1679) approaches nature within social contract theory. In a state of nature without common power, life is war of all against all—solitary, poor, nasty, brutish, and short. Rational covenants transfer rights to a sovereign to secure peace. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets nature most directly—useful for searches such as “thomas hobbes quotes on nature.”
